core_rule: attack/movement availability = core(cap) + (grants(cap) & active_techniques) over trained capabilities; defenses = every defense granted by a trained capability; core ids not yet in data/techniques_v2.json are ignored

acrobatics.description: Anime/acrobatic movement school: cartwheel and wall-assisted kicks. Requires airborne_training and an aerial vertical mode.

anti_grappling.description: Takedown and clinch defense: sprawl, whizzer, jam step, pummel, wall walk and get-ups.

baguazhang.description: Baguazhang: circle walking for angles, palm changes, piercing palms, turning throws and leg sweeps.

bajiquan.description: Bajiquan: explosive close-range stomping punches, top elbow, iron-mountain shoulder lean.

basic_movement.description: Everyone: footwork, feints, lean-back and step-back evasions, clinch break, stand-up.

bjj.description: Guard pulls, sweeps, passes, back takes and submissions.

boxing.description: Punches (jab, cross, hooks, uppercuts, body shots) and boxing defense (parry, shell, slip, roll).

cage_plum.description: Conditional: plum and knees against the cage/wall.

capoeira.description: Capoeira: ginga footwork, low evasions (esquiva, negativa), spinning and crescent kicks, sweeps (rasteira), cartwheels, headbutts.

catch_wrestling.description: Catch wrestling: shots and snap-downs, rides, cross-faces and cradles, neck cranks, double wristlocks and leg locks.

clinch.description: Collar ties, body locks, pummeling and clinch knees.

counter_boxing.description: PROPOSAL (owner decision D7): counter-punching school for Darius Reed's hollow second slot: pull counter and check hook.

hung_gar.description: Hung Gar: rooted horse stance, tiger claws, bridge-arm smashes, no-shadow kick, heavy straight and hooking punches.

inside_combinations.description: Short inside punches: shovel hook, short uppercut.

jeet_kune_do.description: Jeet Kune Do: intercepting lead straight, stop kicks, finger jab, trapping into the straight blast; strong side forward.

karate.description: Distance kicking (side, front, round, spinning) with straight punches.

kickboxing.description: Punches plus round kicks, teeps, checks and knees.

lethwei.description: Lethwei (Burmese boxing): the full Muay Thai arsenal bare-knuckle, plus headbutts and clinch throws.

muay_thai.description: Full Muay Thai school: shin kicks, teeps, straight and clinch knees, elbows, plum, check, catch-and-dump.

pressure_footwork.description: Modifier: cut-off steps that trap an opponent against the wall. Only alongside a striking school.

sanda.description: Kicks, kick catches and catch-sweeps, foot sweeps.

shield.description: Shield frame defense and the counter hook off it.

shuai_jiao.description: Shuai Jiao (Chinese wrestling): quick-grip throws, kick-trips, leg catches; throws and stays standing.

switch_step.description: Modifier: switching stance mid-exchange. Only alongside a school.

taekwondo.description: Taekwondo: fast instep round kicks, cut kicks, spinning and jumping kicks, bouncing footwork; hands low, body punches.

tai_chi.description: Tai Chi (push hands): redirect and neutralize, then issue power (fa jin) to uproot; palm strikes and deflect-parry-punch.

untrained_striking.description: Untrained power: wild hooks, haymakers, straights, shoves, headbutts (street).

wall_boxing.description: Wall ties and punches while pinning an opponent to the wall.

wing_chun.description: Wing Chun: centerline chain punches, hand traps (pak sao, lap sao), deflections (tan sao, bong sao), low stop kicks, elbows.

wrestling.description: Shots, trips, rides, ground control and escapes.
